title: phyllanthus moorei
intro: Phyllanthus moorei, commonly known as the "Maya apple", is a plant species native to Central America, characterized by its green, apple-like fruit. The health benefits of Phyllanthus moorei include its use in treating various liver and kidney disorders, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus moorei include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus moorei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
